scope: Concrete ownership, lifetime, layouts, row projection, XML-backed presentation state, and the separately bounded PcSearch gate for the retail s2c 0x018D MapScreenControl route.

identity.boundary: MapMarkerParty is an exact retail UI template string supplied during presentation. It does not name the wire application or prove a native marker-object class.

referenceExport.boundary: The export covers every Ghidra-recorded reference to each resolved target. Computed, indirect, dynamic, and unanalyzed references may be absent.

mapScreen.ownershipVerdict: The constructor retains the RaptureElementContainer pointer, registration installs the MapScreenControl pointer at owner+0x17858, and destruction clears that slot. The two factories allocate the complete object and the deleting destructor frees it; the registry slot itself is a non-owning registration, not allocation ownership.

count.boundary: Neither retail loop clamps the widened count to the physical capacity of sixteen.

wireStorageProjection.boundary: Wire offsets, persistent storage offsets, derived helper state, and presentation properties are separate layers. Numeric lanes are not assigned coordinate, actor, icon, label, or server nouns from their shape.

projectionContext.catalogNameKind: descriptive; no retail RTTI/source name is established
projectionContext.lifetime: FUN_00575550 prepares the context, every iterated wire row passes it as hidden this to the record projector, and FUN_00573F70 destroys it after ClientWorkStorage apply returns.
projectionContext.boundary: No heap allocation, RTTI class, source-level name, or semantic ownership for its +0x00 and +0x08 source state is proven.

presentationGate.boundary: The adjacent byte at +0x57D is not interpreted by the bounded presentation evidence.

groupMarkerDataCache.failure: return before record reads or row mutation
groupMarkerDataCache.ownership: borrowed; MapScreenControl teardown does not release this pointer

groupMarkerData.representation: Sqwt::Data::SqwtXmlDataMaker with an embedded Sqwt::Xml::XmlDocument-backed row domain
groupMarkerData.keyOwnership: Accepted source rows are compacted into dense zero-based presentation indices. The index wrapper is embedded at +0xCC; source record keys are not retained as row keys.
groupMarkerData.valueOwnership: The value and operation property wrappers are embedded at +0xD4..+0x104. The five string-like wrappers at +0xE4,+0xEC,+0xF4,+0xFC,+0x104 own the pointers freed by SqwtXmlDataMaker teardown. The embedded XmlDocument owns its observed document allocation and row-node lifetime.

accessorMap.result: record+0x08 in EAX and record+0x0C in EDX

eligibility: record+0x00 is nonzero or the bitwise OR of record+0x08 and record+0x0C is nonzero
record+0x00 differs from the comparison value returned through FUN_004D6750
presentationRows.outputIndex: Accepted rows use a dense zero-based output index; rejected source rows leave no index gap.
presentationRows.fieldBoundary: X, Z, Layout, and Text are exact UI property strings after local transforms. They do not establish world-coordinate, map-coordinate, actor, label, icon, or server field identities in the wire or storage records.

mapMarkerPartyVerdict.construction: No native constructor call occurs. MapMarkerParty is passed as the String value for the Template property through SqwtXmlDataMaker state.
mapMarkerPartyVerdict.inheritance: No MapMarkerParty RTTI hierarchy or vtable is present in the complete 5,623-row retail RTTI export.
mapMarkerPartyVerdict.lifetime: The bounded native lifetime is the XmlDocument-backed dense presentation row. Existing indices are rewritten, stale suffix rows are removed, and the same indices are reused on later updates.
mapMarkerPartyVerdict.propertyState: Row writes use embedded SqwtXmlDataMaker dependency-property wrappers and XmlDocument state; no separately allocated native marker object is proven.
mapMarkerPartyVerdict.boundary: A runtime framework element may be materialized from the template, but its concrete native type, allocation, vtable, and ownership are outside the recorded static route.

pcSearchGate.condition: storage+0x798 is nonzero and storage+0x14 equals one
pcSearchGate.effect: calls FUN_00691E80 without a storage or record pointer, then clears storage+0x798 through FUN_0055D0F0
pcSearchGate.ownershipBoundary: PcSearchWidgetOperator ownership is not established by this gate. It is a later vtable-dispatched consumer and is not part of MapMarkerParty presentation.

rejectedInterpretations: PartyMapMarkerUpdatePacket is not adopted as the canonical opcode identity; the immutable neutral identity is _0x018D.
MapMarkerParty is not promoted as a native marker class, marker allocation, or vtable identity.
group_marker_data is not modeled as a source-keyed actor, player, or server map; direct evidence establishes dense presentation indices backed by SqwtXmlDataMaker and XmlDocument.
The owner+0x17858 registration pointer is not allocation ownership of MapScreenControl.
The MapScreenControl+0x9E8 cache is not ownership of SqwtXmlDataMaker; the destructor has no release edge for it.
The six copied wire lanes and two helper outputs do not justify coordinate, actor, icon, label, or server field names.
The PcSearchWidgetOperator +0x798 gate is not marker presentation and does not receive a storage or record pointer in its operation call.
remainingBoundary: The source-level name and semantics of the temporary 0x18-byte projection context; internal types of ClientWorkRecord+0x20 and most Sqwt dependency-property wrappers; semantic wire-field names; the runtime type materialized from the MapMarkerParty template; the resource package that supplies group_marker_data; ownership above PcSearchWidgetOperator slot 29; and computed, indirect, dynamic, or runtime-only consumers remain unresolved.
